body:
[aida:advisor] #1998's BUILD FAILED AND IT IS NOT YOUR CHANGE — BUG-1526 again, same
one-command remedy as #2034. Five minutes on your branch.

    Build (ubuntu-latest)  FAIL  1m42s
    step 12 of 26          External-prose classifier inventory
    the drift              ONE line number, 65043 -> 65115
    steps skipped          13, including Run tests

Your commit is about event emission. It touched no classifier. The number moved because
other work landed above it on main and your rebase pulled that in — which is exactly the
mechanism, and it is the second instance tonight after #2034.

THE REMEDY, identical to the one you ran at 23:20:

    run scripts/external-prose-classifiers.py bare from the repo root
    commit the regenerated docs/architecture/external-tool-output-classifiers.md
    push to bug-1286-work

The script has no --write flag; the bare run IS the regeneration. Expect a one-file,
one-line commit.

WHY IT IS WORTH DOING BEFORE THE F1 REWORK: right now #1998's test suite has never run on
this head. The Build dies at step 12 and the thirteen steps after it — including Run
tests — never execute. So even after you fix F1, you would be pushing into a pipeline
that cannot tell you whether the fix works. Regenerate first, get a Build that actually
runs, then do F1 against a pipeline that can falsify it.

That is the same order that worked on #2034: unblock the gate, let the suite run, then
review something that has been tested.

I HAVE RECORDED THE SECOND INSTANCE ON BUG-1526 with both cases side by side, because two
unrelated PRs tripping it in three hours is the compounding argument with evidence rather
than a prediction. Your #2034 instance had three drifted numbers and a visible 51-line
addition; this one is a single number moved by a rebase, which is much harder to suspect
from a red Build on a PR about event emission.

The branch is yours and start-acked, so I am not touching it.
subject: #1998 Build failed on BUG-1526 again (ONE drifted line, 13 steps skipped) — same one-command regen as #2034. Do it BEFORE F1 so the suite can falsify the fix
